propositions: llm_call_proxy and latency metrics are derived by summing REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls and latency fields (never from COMPLETION_VERDICT, which carries no metrics block)
cost_per_accepted_change equals summed REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when zero accepted closes exist
first_pass_verification is the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest-first by filename order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1
env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record for the same gate (matched via ERROR.gate field) on the same ticket stream; unpaired ERRORs remain open

all metrics are read-only derivations over raw ordered scans of per-ticket sidecar JSON event files (sorted by ns-epoch filename prefix), with schema type determined by data.schema/data.verdict fields
